evidence.title: Breaking Ground On Odisha’s Next Growth Chapter
evidence.excerpt: Adani Group's May 2026 magazine says the groundbreaking of three projects at Bhubaneswar's Info Valley marked the start of construction, including an INR 800 crore data centre.

metadata.source_date_guardrail: The magazine supplies a May 2026 issue label and an embedded page-builder publication value without a timezone, but the article gives no groundbreaking day. published_at therefore remains null and no event day is inferred from the HTTP Last-Modified header or embedded page metadata.
metadata.status_as_of_normalization: 2026-05-01 is the conservative month-start representation of the source's May 2026 issue context, not an asserted groundbreaking or observation day.
metadata.status_scope: The article says the groundbreaking of three Adani projects marked the start of construction and identifies one of those projects as a data centre at Info Valley. This supports one generic under_construction observation for the data-center project; it does not establish excavation, foundations, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, or operation.
metadata.investment_guardrail: INR 800 crore is the reported data-center investment. The over-INR-33,000-crore figure is a three-project aggregate spanning the data center, a thermal power plant, and a cement unit; it is not allocated to the data center beyond the separate INR 800 crore statement and is not power, energy, capacity, PUE, current load, or measured consumption.
metadata.jobs_guardrail: The approximate job forecast is economic context, not a facility-size, capacity, workload, completion, or operation observation.
metadata.identity_guardrail: The article gives no formal facility or campus name. The Adani Info Valley labels are conservative Atlas labels for one campus and one groundbreaking project in a single lineage, not separate buildings, phases, assets, an AdaniConneX facility, or a complete Info Valley inventory.
metadata.role_guardrail: Adani Group authorship and Karan Adani's remarks are source context only. The article does not identify AdaniConneX or an exact owner, operator, developer, landlord, tenant, customer, user, contractor, investor, or utility for the data center, so no standardized roles are assigned.
metadata.classification_guardrail: AI, cloud computing, digital governance, digital infrastructure, and ecosystem language describes future economic enablement. It creates no normalized type, operating model, workload, tenant, customer, user, installed system, or current service observation.
metadata.metric_guardrail: No critical IT load, gross facility load, grid connection, generation nameplate, annual energy, PUE, rack count, or other normalized power, energy, or capacity metric is reported or inferred. The separate thermal power plant is not data-center supply evidence.
metadata.locality_guardrail: Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India is authoritative locality context only. The source supplies no normalized street address, parcel, point, footprint, geometry, geocode, or unique-site claim.
